tickets.title: Prepare Copper Firefly equity vesting and trading calendar
tickets.text: Prepare a single calendar of Tobin Mossbutton’s Copper Firefly option and RSU vesting, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps. Use the full equity plan agreement, grant notices, and insider trading policy to confirm exercise limits and sale restrictions. Planning was relying on memory or portal screenshots.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-12, the agreed follow-up is a single calendar of option and RSU vesting, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps, requested because planning was relying on memory or portal screenshots.

tickets.title: Illustrate Copper Firefly equity sale and exercise options
tickets.text: Prepare an illustration comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, or partial exercise against cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity. Use the review’s findings of several vested option strike prices and no household comparison.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-19, the agreed follow-up is an illustration comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, or partial exercise against cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity, after the review found several vested option strike prices and no household comparison.
